name: Make It Work
description:
Skills that make Claude actually work in your project. Not just generally, but specifically, the way your codebase is built.

Built for engineering teams working on large, complex codebases. Not greenfield side projects. When your codebase has history, domain rules, and legacy decisions baked in, "generally smart" isn't enough. Claude needs to know your project.

go-deep maps your codebase from the inside out and builds a layered documentation system so every Claude session starts grounded in your project's real structure, rules, and use cases. Not generic assumptions.

close-the-gaps acts as a Product Analyst before development begins: it finds every gap in a ticket (unclear language, missing edge cases, conflicting requirements), walks you through them one by one, and outputs a Gherkin-ready refined spec.

The cost of a vague ticket is paid in rework. close-the-gaps makes sure requirements are solid before a single line of code is written.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**.

- **Skills** (5): `close-my-loops` (Build and maintain a personal work profile and open-loop tracker for the user's own job — a markdown…), `close-the-gaps` (Product Analyst session: fetches a ticket, loads project skills, explores affected code, asks gap-analysis questions one at a…), `go-deep` (Builds a 3-tier doc system (CLAUDE.md, orientation maps, domain & UC skills) for any codebase), `shape-the-epic` (Guides a PM through writing a complete, elaboration-ready epic for any work management tool), `slice-the-epic` (Slice a requirement, epic, ticket, or user story into small, independently deliverable increments, and write each slice as…)

Installs with `claude plugin install make-it-work@claude-community` from `insideout-ai/make-it-work`.
